incident: WAN private test monitor persistence failure
confirmedMechanism: An exception from atomic state persistence could escape run without final scoped resource shutdown.
likelyCause: Windows replacement sharing violation; newer valid pending file supports this, but original exception was not captured.
reproduction: Actual Windows reader without FILE_SHARE_DELETE reproduces PermissionError.
fixes: Bounded atomic replacement retry for transient PermissionError
Run-level shielded scoped shutdown after persistence/read/sleep/cancellation failure
Independent controller validates heartbeat freshness and live monitor PID every two seconds
STOP-only fallback for inference and unsettled deployment; confirmation does not depend on billing API
No automatic generation replay from status or timeout
